# Build with Claude Code

> The methodology for building production apps with Claude Code —
> from idea to deployed SaaS, without getting stuck.

Most Claude Code guides document the tool. This repo documents
**how to actually ship something with it.**

---

## What's in this repo

| Folder | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`methodology/`](methodology/) | 6 blank planning document templates — use them for any project |
| [`examples/procuremaster/`](examples/procuremaster/) | All 6 documents filled in for a real AI procurement SaaS |
| [`guides/`](guides/) | Standalone guides on software fundamentals, Claude Code extensions, building desktop/web/SaaS/mobile apps |
| [`setup/`](setup/) | Exact plugins, MCP servers, and subagents used in the course |
| [`cheatsheet.md`](cheatsheet.md) | Quick-reference card |
| [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) | Reusable CLAUDE.md template for any new project |

---

## Quick Start

Clone the starter template (blank 6-document scaffold):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/arjunjanananda10/build-with-claude-code
```

See the complete ProcureMaster reference app (full Next.js + Supabase codebase):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/arjunjanananda10/build-with-claude-code
git checkout reference/procuremaster
```

---

## The 6-Document Methodology

Before writing a single line of code, prepare these six documents.
They give Claude Code the full context it needs to build correctly —
no guessing, no backtracking.

| # | Document | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [PRD](methodology/01-prd-template.md) | What exactly are we building and for whom? |
| 2 | [App Flow](methodology/02-app-flow-template.md) | How does a user move through the product? |
| 3 | [Tech Stack](methodology/03-tech-stack-template.md) | Which exact versions of which libraries? |
| 4 | [Content Guidelines](methodology/04-content-guidelines-template.md) | What does the UI look and feel like? |
| 5 | [Backend Schema](methodology/05-backend-schema-template.md) | What tables, columns, and relationships? |
| 6 | [Implementation Plan](methodology/06-implementation-plan-template.md) | What gets built in what order? |

→ [See a fully worked example for ProcureMaster](examples/procuremaster/)
